They also output the columns as Street, City, Zip, State, and repeat 1 uses "StreetAbr". Explicit repeat 0 sorted NULLs last ("... IS NULL, ... ASC") and got the same LA row, so it failed. Repeat 1 sorted NULLs first ("IS NULL DESC") and matched the gold.

Use integer division without casting to real, so every rate below 1 becomes 0 and many schools tie for lowest. This is a technical pitfall rather than a reasonable reading, since the rate should be fractional.
